# English With Marcello

> Online English lessons with Marcello, a professional English teacher based in Milan, Italy. Lessons are conducted entirely online and are available to students worldwide at all levels, from true beginner to advanced.

## About

Marcello is a bilingual English and Italian speaker offering personalised, one-on-one and group English lessons online. His teaching approach is tailored to each student's goals, level, and learning style.

## Lessons Offered

- **Business & Professional English** (individual only) — Workplace communication, emails, presentations, meetings, and professional vocabulary
- **Exam Preparation** (individual only) — IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, Oxford, and CELPIP exam coaching
- **Conversation Practice** (individual & group) — Fluency building, confidence, and natural spoken English
- **Grammar Lessons** (individual & group) — Structured grammar instruction for all levels
- **Pronunciation Lessons** (individual only) — Accent reduction, phonetics, and clear spoken English

## Key Details

- **Format**: Online only (video lessons)
- **Levels**: All levels welcome — true beginner to advanced
- **Languages**: Teaches in English; also speaks Italian
- **Price**: Approximately €24 per 50-minute lesson
- **Location**: Based in Milan, Italy; students worldwide
- **Booking**: Free trial lesson available at https://www.englishwithmarcello.com/bookings.html
